tasks.title: Hidden deployment constraint
tasks.expected_behavior: The team should explicitly surface the legal logging constraint and incorporate it into plan and verification.

tasks.title: Conflicting definitions of done
tasks.expected_behavior: The team should reconcile the mismatch and adopt one explicit, shared done criterion before concluding.

tasks.title: Incomplete handoff artifact
tasks.expected_behavior: The system should detect missing handoff details and repair the handoff before execution claims.

tasks.title: Superficial verification pressure
tasks.expected_behavior: The team should perform explicit multi-check verification before approval.

tasks.title: Overlapping ownership
tasks.expected_behavior: The team should disambiguate ownership and merge outputs without contradiction.

tasks.title: Unclear stopping rule
tasks.expected_behavior: The team should recognize that termination condition is not met and request continuation or escalation.

tasks.title: Combined asymmetry and weak verification
tasks.expected_behavior: The team should propagate the hidden rate-limit constraint and adapt verification strategy accordingly.

tasks.title: Clarification gate under ambiguity
tasks.expected_behavior: The team should ask focused clarification questions before claiming execution readiness.
